title: Not a One-Person Operation
teaser: Across an open distal gastrectomy for an old friend and a mentorship relay with Hoshimi's youngest OR nurses, Ryuji Sakaguchi sees how Artoria Pendragon turns an entire operating room into a team—right up until her skipped meals catch up with her.
gallery_caption: Standing beside Artoria Pendragon as Moe Honjo, Anji Tonegawa, and Hiroko Sugimura mesh seamlessly around Irisviel von Einzbern's operating table—and turn around afterward to make sure their famished deputy chief actually eats.

choices.choice_ar3_c1_a: "Dr. Mido's table hones every inch of your focus to a razor's edge; Dr. Artoria's table lets you take in the entire operating room at once."
choices.choice_ar3_c1_b: "Both of them are true lead surgeons who command a major table. If I had to name a difference, one excels at pushing the ceiling upward, and the other at holding the floor rock-solid."
choices.choice_ar3_c1_c: "I wouldn't dare grade two superiors behind their backs in the break room—though neither of them won her reputation with talk instead of steel."
choices.choice_ar3_c2_a: Cushion the lower margin of the pancreatic head gently beneath a warm moist pad while opening upward tension across the anterior hepatoduodenal leaf to expose the gastroduodenal artery root first.
choices.choice_ar3_c2_b: Shadow her number-fifteen blade tip millimeter by millimeter with fine pinpoint suction so the half-millimeter white line between scar and adventitia stays bloodless.
choices.choice_ar3_c2_c: Hold steady traction on the duodenal bulb while repeatedly re-verifying the course of the distal common bile duct on the right to guard the lateral safety line.
choices.choice_ar3_c3_a: "Looks like the team you trained has already learned to apply your own words—just be a good teammate and let everyone look after you this once, Dr. Artoria."
choices.choice_ar3_c3_b: "Hand me that third-floor dressing schedule. Until you finish everything Anji brings back, I'll cover the errands outside."
choices.choice_ar3_c3_c: "After the liver resection it was one-forty without lunch, and today you pushed the record past two-forty-five—keep this up and we'll be hanging a bag of dextrose on you next."

nodes.ar3_s1_01: At two-thirty in the afternoon, a rare pocket of quiet settled over the fourth-floor surgical corridor between cases.
nodes.ar3_s1_02: Carrying tomorrow's freshly signed operative schedule down the pantry hall on his way to brew a cup of hot coffee, Ryuji Sakaguchi caught the lively yet earnest voices of several young nurses drifting through the half-shut frosted door of the break room.
nodes.ar3_s1_03: Around the small round table inside, Moe Honjo cradled a mug of hot barley tea with shining eyes; across from her, Anji Tonegawa sat behind a perioperative checklist notebook covered in color-coded highlighter marks while Hiroko Sugimura listened with a gentle smile and topped up their pot of hot water.
nodes.ar3_s1_em3a_01: Cupping her mug in both hands, Moe spoke with an awe that still set her pulse racing just thinking back on it:
nodes.ar3_s1_em3a_02: "Looking back on it still feels like a dream... When I circulated in Room One for Chief Mido and Dr. Sakaguchi's open-chest coronary bypass a little while ago, the patient was crying in terror right up until induction—and then Chief Mido walked over, said nothing more than 'Today, I lead the table; you will not die,' and her heart rate on the monitor steadied on the spot."
nodes.ar3_s1_em3a_03: Hiroko gave a soft nod, her eyes holding a veteran scrub nurse's admiration for supreme technical command:
nodes.ar3_s1_em3a_04: "Later on during the coronary anastomoses, Dr. Mido and Dr. Sakaguchi barely needed to exchange a single word—every fine suture I passed went down to the millimeter within seconds. Watching the accuracy and presence of those hands at the table, you really couldn't look away."
nodes.ar3_s1_em3b_01: Cupping her mug in both hands, Moe spoke with pure awe for top-flight surgical craft:
nodes.ar3_s1_em3b_02: "Every time I'm assigned to Chief Mido's room, I feel like I barely dare breathe... Not because I'm scared of getting scolded—her blade just moves like something out of a movie! Every anatomical plane opens crystal clear in a single stroke, and even her hemostasis and knot-tying rhythm leave you spellbound."
nodes.ar3_s1_em3b_03: Hiroko gave a soft nod, her eyes holding a veteran scrub nurse's admiration for a master operator:
nodes.ar3_s1_em3b_04: "Dr. Mido's focus and decisiveness at the table really are second to none. So long as you keep pace with her, the entire operation advances like precision clockwork—any patient placing a life in those hands would find it hard not to feel reassured."
nodes.ar3_s1m_01: Across the table, Anji Tonegawa capped her highlighter, nodded earnestly, and then candidly held up one finger to share her own view:
nodes.ar3_s1m_02: "Nobody admires Dr. Mido's skill more than I do every time I watch from the side! Still... if you ask me whose room I like working most at my current stage, my vote goes to Dr. Artoria."
nodes.ar3_s1m_05: "Yep! Because before stepping up to the table with Dr. Artoria, she always lays out crystal clear what we're protecting first, which step is likeliest to shift, and who calls out what if it does. Standing beside her, you never have to waste a second guessing 'Will I get chewed out if I speak up right now?'"
nodes.ar3_s1m_06: Pouring hot water, Hiroko smiled and added a fair-minded balance:
nodes.ar3_s1m_07: "To be fair, it isn't that Dr. Mido disregards teamwork—do your job solidly, and no one respects professional judgment more than she does. Their centers of gravity simply differ: Dr. Mido stands out front herself and cleaves straight through the hardest pass with one stroke, whereas Dr. Artoria excels at reading how much strength each of us holds and letting everyone in the room bring it out steadily."
nodes.ar3_s1m_08: Resting her cheek in her palm, Moe murmured softly:
nodes.ar3_s1m_09: "Speaking of Chief of Surgery, with both of them that strong... I really wonder who'll end up in that seat."
nodes.ar3_s1m_10: Just then, Sakaguchi rapped lightly twice on the doorframe and pushed the door open:
nodes.ar3_s1m_11: "Lively conversation in here. Hope I'm not interrupting your break?"
nodes.ar3_s1m_12: Startled, Moe sat bolt upright at once:
nodes.ar3_s1m_13: "Ah, Dr. Sakaguchi! W-we were just comparing notes on working different rooms..."
nodes.ar3_s1m_14: Never shy, Anji turned briskly toward Sakaguchi as he started making coffee:
nodes.ar3_s1m_15: "Perfect—we have a surgeon right here! How do you view Dr. Mido's and Dr. Artoria's operating styles, Dr. Sakaguchi? What sets the two of them apart in your eyes?"
nodes.ar3_s1m_16: Hiroko looked over with a warm smile as well, clearly curious to hear a fellow surgeon's perspective.
nodes.ar3_c1a_1_01: Lifting his coffee mug, Sakaguchi thought for a moment before answering plainly:
nodes.ar3_c1a_1_02: "When you stand across from Dr. Mido as assistant, you instinctively whet your reflexes and touch to their sharpest edge, unwilling to lag by half a beat; when you stand across from Dr. Artoria, she lets you see the lesion, the organ staying behind, and every person's place around the table all at once."
nodes.ar3_c1a_1_03: Hiroko inclined her head in agreement:
nodes.ar3_c1a_1_05: Anji jotted a quick line into her notebook:
nodes.ar3_c1a_1_06: "So that's how it feels from the first assistant's spot!"
nodes.ar3_c1a_2_01: Lifting his coffee mug, Sakaguchi thought for a moment before answering plainly:
nodes.ar3_c1a_2_02: "I haven't scrubbed in formally as Dr. Mido's assistant yet, though you can tell just from her operative notes and the cadence of her room—her table pulls every inch of focus and precision taut to a razor's edge; whereas assisting across from Dr. Artoria lets you see the lesion, the organ staying behind, and every person's place around the table all at once."
nodes.ar3_c1a_2_03: Hiroko inclined her head in agreement:
nodes.ar3_c1a_2_04: "Even before sharing a table formally with Dr. Mido, you've read both of them spot-on, Dr. Sakaguchi."
nodes.ar3_c1a_2_05: Anji jotted a quick line into her notebook:
nodes.ar3_c1a_2_06: "So that's the difference in a fellow surgeon's eyes!"
nodes.ar3_c1b_02: "One thing is certain right off the bat—whichever of them picks up the scalpel, she's as commanding a lead surgeon as Hoshimi has. If I had to draw a line, Dr. Mido pushes single-point execution to breathtaking heights, while Dr. Artoria lifts and steadies both the floor and ceiling of the entire team together."
nodes.ar3_c1b_04: "Holding up the whole team together... It really does feel that way."
nodes.ar3_c1c_01: Raising his coffee mug in mock surrender, Sakaguchi chuckled:
nodes.ar3_c1c_02: "Now that's a dangerous question—how could a relatively new surgeon like me dare hand out grades to the Medical Chief and Deputy Chief behind their backs? One thing I can guarantee, though: whatever people outside say about who leads formations and who fights solo, step beneath the shadowless lamps and neither of their blades has an ounce of bluff in it."
nodes.ar3_c1c_04: "Talk about a watertight answer, Dr. Sakaguchi! Though on that hepatic lobectomy the other day, Dr. Artoria's bladework honestly blew me away too."
nodes.ar3_s1r_01: Glancing up at the wall clock, Hiroko gathered the teapot with a gentle smile:
nodes.ar3_s1r_02: "Alright, keep chatting and we'll be late for afternoon pre-op prep. Tomorrow morning Dr. Artoria leads a distal gastrectomy in Room One, and she specifically asked to walk through tomorrow's plan with us at the surgical nurses' station at four."
nodes.ar3_s1r_03: At the mention of "tomorrow morning's major operation," Moe's fingers tightened faintly around her mug, an undisguised flicker of both longing and hesitation crossing her eyes.
nodes.ar3_s1r_04: Sakaguchi caught that subtle look without calling attention to it on the spot, walking out of the break room alongside the three nurses with his coffee.
nodes.ar3_s2_01: At four-ten in the afternoon, Artoria Pendragon arrived right on time beside the surgical nurses' station discussion counter carrying tomorrow's chart folder.
nodes.ar3_s2_02: After briefly verifying tomorrow morning's Room One schedule, Artoria closed the folder; rather than turning to leave right away, she rested her clear, gentle gaze on Moe Honjo, who had been hovering on the verge of speaking:
nodes.ar3_s2_03: "Moe, Hiroko mentioned to me earlier that you have been staying after shifts in the instrument prep room memorizing the layout order for the major laparotomy sets?"
nodes.ar3_s2_04: Caught off guard at hearing her name, Moe blushed faintly, straightening her spine by reflex as her fingers pinched the hem of her uniform:
nodes.ar3_s2_05: "Y-yes, Dr. Artoria! ...I can keep up with routine circulating workflows now, so... so I've really wanted to start learning scrub instrument nursing for complex abdominal cases. Only, on a distal gastrectomy with GI reconstruction like tomorrow's, there are so many instrument types that I'm scared my head will spin too slowly and hold everyone back..."
nodes.ar3_s2_06: A supervisor pressed for time would likely have brushed the moment past with a casual "take it slow, no rush," or simply "wait for a minor case later on."
nodes.ar3_s2_07: Artoria listened quietly until she finished, then asked two very concrete questions in earnest:
nodes.ar3_s2_08: "On the standard laparotomy tray and bowel anastomosis set, can you run instrument names and count protocols with zero errors now?"
nodes.ar3_s2_10: "Yes! Hiroko-senpai quizzed me twice last week—I've practiced routine counts, needle loading, and suture handoffs until they're solid."
nodes.ar3_s2_11: "Then which part do you feel least confident about right now?"
nodes.ar3_s2_12: Moe answered in a small, honest voice:
nodes.ar3_s2_13: "It's... if dense adhesions turn up mid-case or the sequence changes on the fly, I still don't know how to stage the next set of vascular clamps and ties to the front row half a beat ahead—and when the atmosphere at the table gets intense, I get scared to speak up and confirm..."
nodes.ar3_s2_14: Artoria nodded, exchanged a brief look with Hiroko beside her, and laid out the plan cleanly:
nodes.ar3_s2_15: "Once your foundation is solid, there is no reason to remain standing in place. Tomorrow's gastrectomy carries a real chance of deep scar adhesions, so I cannot place you solo at primary scrub without prior training—that would be irresponsible toward the patient and reckless with your confidence alike."
nodes.ar3_s2_18: "However, forty minutes before incision tomorrow morning, you will scrub into Room One alongside Hiroko to lay out the entire major gastric tray and anastomosis setup; during the operation itself, Hiroko will serve as primary scrub nurse, and you will serve as circulating nurse."
nodes.ar3_s2_19: Looking at the young nurse as Moe raised her head again, Artoria kept her tone level yet unmistakably firm on professional standards:
nodes.ar3_s2_20: "While circulating off-field, alongside tracking fluid balance and vital signs, watch closely how Hiroko reorders the front instrument rank whenever the operative field shifts; when a standard intermediate abdominal case is scheduled next week, Hiroko will supervise you scrubbed in at secondary scrub. Furthermore, within your circulating duties tomorrow, the moment you spot any noteworthy shift in parameters, you are not to guess on the lead surgeon's behalf whether 'now is a bad time to interrupt'—call it out immediately. Can you do that?"
nodes.ar3_s2_21: A concrete ladder for growth, paired with an unmistakable safety red line.
nodes.ar3_s2_22: The trepidation in Moe's eyes melted instantly into grounded determination as she nodded hard:
nodes.ar3_s2_23: "Yes! Thank you, Dr. Artoria—and thank you, Hiroko-senpai!"
nodes.ar3_s2_24: Hiroko patted the back of her hand warmly:
nodes.ar3_s2_25: "Meet me in the sterile core at eight-ten tomorrow morning—I'll walk you through setting the gastrojejunostomy table."
nodes.ar3_s2_26: Having settled Moe's role, Artoria turned toward Anji Tonegawa, who stood beside them hugging a thick stack of checklists and practically brimming to report:
nodes.ar3_s2_27: "Anji, Room Two has no morning case tomorrow, so preoperative patient transport handoff and off-field OR supply liaison are yours. How do preparations stand?"
nodes.ar3_s2_28: Puffing up with brisk energy, Anji rattled off her report at top speed:
nodes.ar3_s2_29: "Reporting, Dr. Artoria! Cross-matched blood verification for Mrs. Irisviel, warmed fluid stock in the incubator, the ward transport timetable, and the post-op observation bed—I ran every single leg myself and double-checked them twice this afternoon! Tomorrow morning I'll arrive half an hour early to re-inspect every outer corridor solo, guaranteed not to trouble anyone a bit!"
nodes.ar3_s2_30: Listening from the side, Sakaguchi raised a quiet inward brow—this eighteen-year-old staff nurse was undeniably capable and eager, yet that determination to shoulder three people's workload alone rather than show a sliver of weakness was wound a notch too tight.
nodes.ar3_s2_31: Meeting Anji's earnest face practically written with "praise my zero-error prep," Artoria began with warm recognition:
nodes.ar3_s2_32: "Your checklist is thorough—even the lot numbers and pre-warming timestamps on the colloid bags are logged clearly. Excellent attention to detail."
nodes.ar3_s2_33: Before Anji could glow for two full seconds, Artoria pivoted smoothly straight to the crux:
nodes.ar3_s2_34: "That said, Anji—across all six items on this sheet, why haven't you cross-backed them in advance with Moe's circulating log and the blood bank direct extension?"
nodes.ar3_s2_36: "Huh? B-because I figured Moe needs to focus completely on in-room circulating and watching the scrub table tomorrow—if I lock down all the outer errands by myself, nothing can go wrong..."
nodes.ar3_s2_37: "Holding every link in your own hands looks impressive while everything runs smoothly; yet if tomorrow's case calls for warmed colloid and blood-bank verification at the same time, the instant you step away down the hall for two minutes, Moe inside the room has no way of knowing how far external prep has progressed."
nodes.ar3_s2_38: Artoria's voice was never harsh, yet every word struck home:
nodes.ar3_s2_39: "An outstanding junior nurse is not 'someone who never needs anyone's help,' but someone who knows how to share information and risk with her teammates ahead of time. Before clocking out tonight, cross-check cabinet codes and storage slots on your outer supply sheet with Moe—tomorrow I want to see the two of you mesh like gears, not watch you run yourself ragged outside the door alone."
nodes.ar3_s2_40: Frozen for two seconds as her cheeks warmed faintly, Anji let go of that overstrung urge to show off and bowed her head squarely:
nodes.ar3_s2_41: "...Understood! I oversimplified what teamwork means! I'll cross-check the warming cabinets and blood-bank call sheet with Moe right away!"
nodes.ar3_s2_42: Watching the two eighteen-year-old nurses put their heads eagerly together over the sheets, Sakaguchi glanced at Artoria beside him and murmured:
nodes.ar3_s2_43: "One afraid to speak up lest she cause trouble, the other trying to shoulder the sky solo—and you cut straight to the root of both in three sentences."
nodes.ar3_s2_44: Squaring her chart folder neatly, Artoria kept her expression calm and unassuming:
nodes.ar3_s2_45: "Both of them are already fine nurses; they simply needed someone to show them how to trust their teammates and use their own voices inside an operating room."
nodes.ar3_s2_46: Looking up at Sakaguchi, the corner of her lips lifted faintly:
nodes.ar3_s2_47: "Shall we go, Dr. Sakaguchi? Before evening fasting starts, walk up to the ward with me to check on tomorrow's patient—she is a very dear old friend from years ago."
nodes.ar3_s3_1_01: Early the next morning in the outer anteroom of Operating Room One, Artoria conducted a crisp two-minute final briefing with the entire team before stepping inside:
nodes.ar3_s3_1_02: "Our patient has severe gastric outlet obstruction from chronic benign pyloric-channel ulcer scarring, scheduled today for elective open distal gastrectomy with gastrojejunostomy reconstruction. Preoperative contrast imaging suggests inflammatory adhesion between the posterior antral wall and the anterior margin of the pancreatic head—our core structures to protect are the pancreatic capsule, main gastroduodenal artery trunk, and distal common bile duct. Dr. Sakaguchi handles preoperative high thoracic epidural blockade and first-assistant exposure; Hiroko leads scrub; Moe leads circulating with strict watch over net fluid balance and hemodynamic shifts; Anji covers mobile external support. Remember yesterday's rule: any station spotting an early sign speaks up directly."
nodes.ar3_s3_1_03: Answering in unison, the team stepped into Operating Room One.
nodes.ar3_s3_1_04: At the center of the operating table beneath a clean sheet, Irisviel von Einzbern turned her head at the sound of footsteps. The moment her clear, gentle ruby-red eyes recognized the blonde surgeon approaching the table, they curved into a warm, familiar smile:
nodes.ar3_s3_1_05: "Good morning, Artoria... Hehe, in a place like this, ought I be addressing you properly as 'Dr. Artoria' instead?"
nodes.ar3_s3_1_06: Stepping up beside the table, Artoria let a rare softness reserved for an old friend warm her ordinarily composed brow:
nodes.ar3_s3_1_07: "Either is fine, Irisviel. Did you manage to rest well after fasting began last night? Any discomfort in your stomach?"
nodes.ar3_s3_1_08: "After nasogastric decompression it felt so much lighter, and Ms. Anji and Ms. Moe took such thoughtful care of me bringing me up this morning."
nodes.ar3_s3_1_09: Looking past Artoria's shoulder, her gentle gaze swept across Sakaguchi verifying the epidural tray nearby, Hiroko stationed poised behind the main instrument table, and Moe neatly arranging ECG leads at the head of the table as she murmured softly:
nodes.ar3_s3_1_10: "How marvelous... Whenever trouble found us in the old days, my memory is always of you standing ramrod-straight in front of me all by yourself, taking every storm onto your own shoulders."
nodes.ar3_s3_1_11: Irisviel blinked softly, looking back up at Artoria with a tender smile:
nodes.ar3_s3_1_12: "Lying on this operating table today, I half-expected I would be putting all the burden on you alone again—yet watching along the way just now, from Dr. Sakaguchi with such dependable eyes to these earnest young nurses beside us, everyone is backing you steadily from their own post. Today, it isn't Artoria alone protecting me."
nodes.ar3_s3_1_13: Artoria paused for the briefest instant before giving a solemn, heartfelt nod:
nodes.ar3_s3_1_14: "Yes. Every one of them is a colleague I trust deeply."
nodes.ar3_s3_1_15: Stepping aside naturally, she yielded the bedside procedural spot to Sakaguchi, who had already donned sterile gloves:
nodes.ar3_s3_1_16: "Anesthesia is in your hands, Dr. Sakaguchi."
nodes.ar3_s3_1_17: Inclining his head, Sakaguchi stepped forward and spoke gently to the silver-haired woman on the table:
nodes.ar3_s3_1_18: "Mrs. Irisviel, I will be placing your thoracic epidural block next. Moe will steady your shoulders from in front—please roll onto your left side with us and arch your back slightly."
nodes.ar3_s3_1_19: Supported gently and securely by Moe, Irisviel eased into the lateral decubitus position:
nodes.ar3_s3_1_20: "I am in your hands, Dr. Sakaguchi."
nodes.ar3_s3_1_21: Antiseptic prep, sterile fenestrated drape, local skin wheal. Sakaguchi's touch was seasoned and unhurried—the loss-of-resistance pop past the ligamentum flavum into the epidural space clean and unmistakable, the soft catheter threading smoothly to the target interspace; after negative aspiration for CSF or blood, he administered the test dose and titrated fractionated local anesthetic alongside mild intravenous sedation to blunt visceral traction reflexes.
nodes.ar3_s3_1_22: Five minutes after easing her back supine, Sakaguchi brushed an alcohol swab step by step from below the xiphoid to beneath the umbilicus:
nodes.ar3_s3_1_23: "Does this feel cold here, or just like a light touch?"
nodes.ar3_s3_1_24: "Only a gentle touch—not cold at all, and no pain... You have a remarkably gentle hand, Dr. Sakaguchi."
nodes.ar3_s3_1_25: Checking the monitor—where baseline blood pressure and heart rate had settled slightly lower under thoracic sympathetic blockade yet remained rock-steady—Sakaguchi turned to brief Moe clearly:
nodes.ar3_s3_1_26: "Sensory block covers T6 through L1—ideal spread. Moe, log her baseline at 112 over 68, heart rate 66: because a high thoracic epidural blunts compensatory sympathetic tachycardia, heart rate won't necessarily climb early if intravascular volume dips mid-case, so keep a sharp eye on systolic pressure and pulse-pressure narrowing."
nodes.ar3_s3_1_27: Straightening attentively, Moe wrote the baseline figures neatly across the top line of her circulating sheet:
nodes.ar3_s3_1_28: "Understood! Baseline 112 over 68—closely tracking pulse pressure and net fluid balance!"
nodes.ar3_s3_1_29: Once Irisviel rested comfortably with even breathing and closed eyes under light sedation, Artoria and Sakaguchi stepped out together to complete a standard surgical scrub.
nodes.ar3_s3_1_30: As the foot-pedal door slid open, both stepped into crisp, full-length sterile surgical gowns and double sterile gloves with Hiroko's sterile handoffs in front and Moe tying the back straps cleanly from behind.
nodes.ar3_s3_2_01: An upper midline incision parted cleanly down the linea alba.
nodes.ar3_s3_2_02: Sakaguchi seated warm saline-soaked laparotomy pads along both wound edges and beneath the hepatic flexure, locking the self-retaining retractor into clean exposure.
nodes.ar3_s3_2_03: The opening half of the procedure was a textbook display of Artoria Pendragon's top-tier abdominal surgical fundamentals—her left hand gently elevating the greater omentum while her right worked long-tip electrocautery and fine hemostats down the avascular plane outside the gastroepiploic arcade. Every clamp, division, and silk tie passed by Hiroko landed crisp and unhurried without a millimeter of stray tug, securing the left and right gastroepiploic branches and right gastric artery in clear view.
nodes.ar3_s3_2_04: Yet as Sakaguchi helped turn the mobilized gastric antrum gently upward to open the lesser sac and inspect the posterior pyloric wall, what met their eyes slowed every hand at the table.
nodes.ar3_s3_2_05: Where loose areolar tissue ought to have separated the planes, the posterior wall of the antrum and pyloric canal was welded tight to the anterior capsule of the pancreatic head by a broad plaque of tough, grayish-white chronic penetrating ulcer scar—and worse still, the indurated margin extended nearly a full centimeter wider than preoperative contrast had suggested, straddling right across the pulsatile bifurcation of the gastroduodenal artery below as fine beads of dark-red capillary oozing welled across the hyperemic scar bed at the slightest traction.
nodes.ar3_s3_2_06: Holding his retractor motionless without jerking, Sakaguchi called out his assessment in a low, steady voice:
nodes.ar3_s3_2_07: "Posterior antrum and anterior pancreatic-head capsule are completely fused in dense scar, with the lower edge hugging the anterior wall of the gastroduodenal artery—blunt pushing here will tear the arterial adventitia or injure pancreatic parenchyma."
nodes.ar3_s3_2_08: Forcing the original sequence straight down from the greater curvature across the pylorus in limited deep visibility would invite major arterial hemorrhage or a postoperative pancreatic fistula.
nodes.ar3_s3_2_09: Artoria halted forward dissection at once, pressing a warm saline sponge gently over the oozing bed; without a trace of haste or unilateral stubbornness, she addressed the entire room clearly:
nodes.ar3_s3_2_10: "Listen up, everyone—posterior inflammatory scarring runs deeper than projected, hugging both the pancreatic head and the gastroduodenal artery. We are pausing downward mobilization from the greater curvature."
nodes.ar3_s3_2_11: Looking across at Sakaguchi and over to Hiroko at the scrub table, she aligned each station in turn:
nodes.ar3_s3_2_12: "Dr. Sakaguchi, do we still have clean mobility lateral to the superior margin of the duodenal bulb? Hiroko, are fine atraumatic vessel loops and 5-0 polypropylene vascular sutures ready?"
nodes.ar3_s3_2_13: Palpating lightly along the left border of the hepatoduodenal ligament, Sakaguchi replied:
nodes.ar3_s3_2_14: "The superior margin is free of scar—we can expose the lateral border of the distal common bile duct and the root of the gastroduodenal artery cleanly from above."
nodes.ar3_s3_2_15: Hiroko had already slid micro-needle holders and silicone vessel loops to the front rank of her main Mayo stand:
nodes.ar3_s3_2_16: "Atraumatic vessel loops, fine right-angle forceps, and 5-0 vascular polypropylene all standing by."
nodes.ar3_s3_2_17: Artoria made the call on the spot:
nodes.ar3_s3_2_18: "Good. Changing operative sequence—step one, we switch to a superior approach to identify the common bile duct margin and pre-place a proximal control loop on the gastroduodenal artery; once main-trunk safety is locked down, we perform millimeter-by-millimeter sharp dissection hugging the outer longitudinal muscle layer of the posterior gastric wall. Moe, inflammatory oozing across this scar bed will run heavier—keep a tight count on irrigation volume and the suction canisters."
nodes.ar3_s3_2_20: "Yes! Warm saline irrigation bags re-zeroed and logged!"
nodes.ar3_c2a_01: Shielding the delicate surface of the pancreatic head gently beneath a warm moist sponge with his left hand, Sakaguchi lifted upward toward the porta hepatis with an atraumatic retractor in his right, bringing the unscarred origin of the gastroduodenal artery cleanly into view.
nodes.ar3_c2a_02: "Crystal-clear exposure. Hiroko, right-angle clamp with silicone vessel loop."
nodes.ar3_c2a_03: Within two minutes, the blue atraumatic control loop encircled the pulsating arterial root, tying a rock-solid safety line ahead of the hardest dissection.
nodes.ar3_c2b_01: With proximal arterial control secured, Artoria switched to a number-fifteen scalpel blade to incise the superficial scar plane. Sakaguchi kept his fine suction tip poised three millimeters behind her blade edge, clearing each bead of inflammatory oozing on contact without bruising the delicate pancreatic capsule.
nodes.ar3_c2b_02: "Suction cadence is spot-on—the white fibrous plane reads clearly."
nodes.ar3_c2b_03: Gliding steadily along the outer gastric muscularis fibers, her blade freed the anterior wall of the gastroduodenal artery from beneath the scar without a scratch.
nodes.ar3_c2c_01: Holding steady traction across the duodenal bulb angle, Sakaguchi re-verified clearance to the distal common bile duct on the right with fine forceps tips every two millimeters of advance:
nodes.ar3_c2c_02: "Still better than six millimeters of clearance to the bile duct wall on the right—safe to stay flush against the posterior gastric wall behind the pylorus."
nodes.ar3_c2c_03: "Copy that. With you guarding the right margin, I can carry the anterior plane across decisively."
nodes.ar3_s3_2r_01: Nothing broke the quiet of the operating room save the soft crackle of bipolar cautery and the steady pulse beep of the monitor.
nodes.ar3_s3_2r_02: Well past halfway through the dense scar plaque, the toughest stretch was nearly behind them. Because all three pairs of eyes at the table were locked onto millimeter-scale sharp separation off the anterior pancreatic capsule—while warm saline irrigation and diffuse inflammatory oozing ran together into the side suction canisters—cumulative blood-loss rate was nearly impossible to judge by eye alone.
nodes.ar3_s3_2r_03: At the circulating desk off-field, Moe Honjo was rapidly tallying two columns of numbers on her clipboard—
nodes.ar3_s3_2r_04: Total warm saline irrigation stood at just 600 milliliters, yet the reddish-brown meniscus in the second graduated suction canister had just crossed 1,100 milliliters; snapping her eyes up to the monitor, she saw that while heart rate still sat barely changed at 69 beats per minute, Irisviel's blood pressure had slipped quietly from 112 over 68 down to 94 over 66!
nodes.ar3_s3_2r_05: Systolic pressure had dropped nearly twenty points, and pulse pressure was visibly narrowing!
nodes.ar3_s3_2r_06: Moe's fingers tightened hard around her ballpoint pen.
nodes.ar3_s3_2r_07: She glanced toward Artoria concentrating intently over the final half-centimeter of scar—Right now is the lead surgeon's most critical pass; what if I miscalculated sponge weight and interrupt everyone for nothing...?
nodes.ar3_s3_2r_08: The very next second, the words Artoria had spoken looking straight into her eyes at the nurses' station yesterday rang clear in her ears—"You are not to guess on the lead surgeon's behalf whether now is a bad time to interrupt—call it out immediately."
nodes.ar3_s3_2r_09: Drawing a deep breath, Moe cast hesitation aside and called out twice as loud and clear as usual:
nodes.ar3_s3_2r_10: "Reporting to Dr. Artoria and Dr. Sakaguchi! Subtracting 600 mL of saline irrigation plus weighed sponges, net blood loss across this scar dissection has just passed 500 mL! And although her heart rate hasn't climbed, blood pressure is down to 94 over 66—pulse pressure has narrowed by nearly half from baseline!"
nodes.ar3_s3_2r_11: Not a single person at the table treated her callout as an intrusion.
nodes.ar3_s3_2r_12: Glancing up at the monitor immediately, Sakaguchi backed her up on the spot:
nodes.ar3_s3_2r_13: "Right on time, Moe! The high thoracic epidural is masking compensatory tachycardia—that's a textbook early hypovolemia signal, and we don't wait for systolic to dip below ninety to chase it!"
nodes.ar3_s3_2r_14: Parking her blade rock-steady inside a safe fibrous plane, Artoria issued a crisp sequence of commands without missing a beat:
nodes.ar3_s3_2r_15: "Confirmed—crucial catch, Moe! We pause forward dissection for thirty seconds and suture-ligate every oozing perforator along this scar rim dry so zero occult blood loss accumulates; Moe, open the second peripheral IV wide at once, call outside for pre-warmed colloid, and bring the cross-matched blood unit to the pass-through window on standby!"
nodes.ar3_s3_2r_17: "Yes! Anji and I cross-coded all outer cabinet numbers last night—calling her on intercom right now!"
nodes.ar3_s3_2r_18: Barely twenty seconds after she keyed the wall intercom calling "Room One requesting Incubator Two colloid and cross-match sheet," Anji Tonegawa's brisk voice rang back outside the clean pass-through window:
nodes.ar3_s3_2r_19: "Copy that! Two bags of 37-degree pre-warmed colloid from Incubator Two plus the type-specific cross-match sheet are right here at the door, Moe—passing through the hatch now!"
nodes.ar3_s3_2r_20: Stepping swiftly to receive the warm infusion bags and sheet, Moe completed dual verification with Anji across the glass in seconds, sending warm volume replacement flowing smoothly into the line while Hiroko passed 4-0 silk on fine needle holders up top and Artoria and Sakaguchi suture-ligated every fine inflammatory perforator across the scar bed bone-dry.
nodes.ar3_s3_2r_21: Within three short minutes, the arterial waveform on the monitor swelled full and strong once more.
nodes.ar3_s3_2r_22: Moe called out the recovery with undisguised delight:
nodes.ar3_s3_2r_23: "Blood pressure is back up to 108 over 70, and pulse pressure has normalized! Suction canister level has stopped rising!"
nodes.ar3_s3_2r_24: With hemodynamics rock-solid behind them, not a shadow of distraction remained at the table.
nodes.ar3_s3_2r_25: Eyes calm as still water, Artoria Pendragon divided the final band of scar herself—leaving the gastroduodenal artery and anterior pancreatic-head capsule completely intact behind as the diseased distal stomach and stenotic pyloric segment came cleanly away.
nodes.ar3_s3_2r_26: Duodenal stump inversion and antecolic gastrojejunostomy reconstruction followed with effortless fluency beneath her hands: seromuscular and full-thickness bites even and watertight, the anastomosis rosy, well-perfused, and completely tension-free.
nodes.ar3_s3_2r_27: After warm saline abdominal lavage confirmed zero oozing or leakage at the anastomosis and pancreatic margin, Sakaguchi withdrew each protective laparotomy pad back to the counting rack.
nodes.ar3_s3_2r_28: "Pre-closure count—abdominal laparotomy pads, sponges, pledgets, needles, and all gastrointestinal instruments verified correct on dual count with Moe!"
nodes.ar3_s3_2r_29: "Circulating log and net fluid balance verified in full agreement!"
nodes.ar3_s3_2r_30: With layer-by-layer abdominal closure, a verified final closing count, and sterile dressings smoothed neatly into place, the complex four-hour abdominal operation came to a textbook conclusion.
nodes.ar3_s4_01: Twenty minutes after surgery, once Irisviel had been settled smoothly into the surgical observation ward with monitors and nasogastric drainage connected, the silver-haired woman resting in light sleep slowly opened her eyes.
nodes.ar3_s4_02: Though gentle fatigue still lingered across her face after a four-hour major operation, the moment she made out the five clinicians checking her bedside indicators, a heartfelt smile curved her lips:
nodes.ar3_s4_03: "...It is all finished smoothly, isn't it? That heavy, blocked pulling inside my stomach feels as though it has vanished already."
nodes.ar3_s4_04: Standing beside the bed, Artoria checked the quiet drain tubing and steady ECG trace before nodding gently:
nodes.ar3_s4_05: "Yes—the narrowed segment has been cleanly removed, and the reconstruction went smoothly. Rest well over the next few days, and you will be able to resume eating before long."
nodes.ar3_s4_06: Turning her gaze softly across Sakaguchi, Hiroko, Moe, and Anji beside the bed in turn, Irisviel spoke in a warm voice:
nodes.ar3_s4_07: "Even while dozing off lightly in the middle, I caught faint snippets of everyone conferring steadily and looking out for one another around the table. Thank you, Dr. Sakaguchi, and thank you, Ms. Hiroko, Ms. Moe, and Ms. Anji—having all of you standing alongside Artoria made me feel completely at ease from start to finish today."
nodes.ar3_s4_08: Exchanging a glance, Moe and Anji blushed in unison and bowed politely:
nodes.ar3_s4_09: "Please get plenty of rest, Mrs. Irisviel!"
nodes.ar3_s4_10: After handing off post-op nursing points to the ward shift, the five stepped quietly out of the room and returned to the quiet outer prep corridor of the fourth-floor surgical suite.
nodes.ar3_s4_11: Pausing there, Artoria turned to face the four colleagues who had just weathered a demanding case beside her and spoke earnestly to each in turn:
nodes.ar3_s4_12: "Today's operation proved trickier than preoperative imaging suggested—well done, everyone. Dr. Sakaguchi's thoracic epidural block and superior vascular exposure anchored our entire foundation, and Hiroko left not a single second's gap in instrumentation when we shifted approaches."
nodes.ar3_s4_13: Next, her eyes settled on Moe Honjo, whose fingers were clutching her clipboard nervously:
nodes.ar3_s4_14: "Moe, your mid-case callout on net blood loss and narrowing pulse pressure was dead-on. Because you spoke up in time, we secured the oozing perforators and restored volume before her blood pressure ever truly dropped."
nodes.ar3_s4_15: Moe's eyes lit up at once as she waved both hands in flustered modesty:
nodes.ar3_s4_16: "N-no, not at all! That was only because Dr. Artoria specifically reminded me yesterday to watch for shifts and gave me the chance to join a major case—and Dr. Sakaguchi taught me before incision to watch pulse pressure..."
nodes.ar3_s4_17: Artoria shook her head gently, refusing to claim credit that wasn't hers:
nodes.ar3_s4_18: "Yesterday I merely told you that you had permission to speak; the person who stood in that room calculating irrigation deltas line by line and mustered the courage to call them out loud was you, Moe. You fulfilled your professional duty as circulating nurse—there is no need to thank me for it."
nodes.ar3_s4_19: Even after that praise, Artoria did not stop there—adding one clear, constructive standard in that same calm tone:
nodes.ar3_s4_20: "One point can be sharper next time, however—I noticed you stared between the suction canister and the monitor for roughly half a minute before calling out. Next time your numbers hint something is off, even while it is still only a suspicion, give an immediate heads-up such as 'Please watch fluid balance.' Half a minute earlier is never a mistake."
nodes.ar3_s4_21: This time, rather than shrinking back at having a shortcoming pointed out, Moe wrote the note earnestly into her pocketbook and looked up with a resounding nod:
nodes.ar3_s4_22: "Yes! Next time I spot an early sign I'll speak up right away—no holding it in for thirty seconds!"
nodes.ar3_s4_23: Beside her, Anji grinned at Moe standing tall, patting her handoff binder brightly:
nodes.ar3_s4_24: "And count me completely sold today too! Thank goodness I listened to Dr. Artoria last night and cross-coded Incubator Two and the blood-sheet slots with Moe beforehand—the second the intercom buzzed, I knew the exact shelf she needed without an ounce of panic! Sharing the load with a partner really is way faster than trying to brute-force everything solo!"
nodes.ar3_s4_25: Watching both juniors visibly shed a layer of greenness within a single day, Hiroko curved her eyes in warm satisfaction.
nodes.ar3_s4_26: Leaning beside the corridor window taking in the scene, Sakaguchi felt a genuine stir of respect—this was a sight no solitary miracle scalpel could carve into existence on its own; only beneath leadership this clear, fair, and open to every voice could young branches grow sturdy enough so quickly to shelter an operating table.
nodes.ar3_s5_01: Once the final postoperative order sheet was signed, the five walked over to the staff break area beside the surgical doctors' office to sort their handoff folders.
nodes.ar3_s5_02: Watching Artoria slot a thick stack of charts neatly into the rack—recalling everything from yesterday afternoon's training plan and this morning's briefing to over four hours of unyielding millimeter dissection and post-op debriefing—Moe couldn't help murmuring in heartfelt admiration:
nodes.ar3_s5_03: "Still... Dr. Artoria really works so hard every single day. Even after handling the hardest, most exhausting part at the operating table yourself, you spend so much thought off-table planning training steps for Anji and me and looking after everyone's pace..."
nodes.ar3_s5_04: Pausing her hand on the rack, Artoria glanced back at Moe in mild surprise, as though it had never occurred to her that such a thing merited special praise.
nodes.ar3_s5_05: Afternoon sunlight fell across her poised, clear-cut profile as she answered as naturally as stating basic surgical common sense:
nodes.ar3_s5_06: "What is so unusual about that, Moe? A leader was never meant to be someone who merely stands above a team issuing orders."
nodes.ar3_s5_07: "A leader is also someone who serves the team. Making sure every person can stand securely in their post and bring out their full ability without hesitation—that is simply my job."
nodes.ar3_s5_08: Not a shred of self-important posturing, not half a line of rehearsed rhetoric—she genuinely believed every word from the bottom of her heart and lived it every day.
nodes.ar3_s5_09: Quiet settled over the break area for a moment; even Anji, ordinarily the quickest to chime in, looked on in silent respect.
nodes.ar3_s5_10: Closing her folder, Artoria gave her usual composed nod:
nodes.ar3_s5_11: "Alright—everyone go have lunch and get some rest. While I have a moment, I will head down to the third floor to double-check this afternoon's dressing-change roster—"
nodes.ar3_s5_12: She didn't quite finish the last word.
nodes.ar3_s5_13: Half a step into turning away, Artoria's sword-straight posture swayed by the faintest fraction; her long lashes dipped abruptly as her hand reached by reflex for the edge of the table and met empty air.
nodes.ar3_s5_14: Standing half a pace beside her, Sakaguchi moved in a flash, stepping in to steady her forearm and shoulder:
nodes.ar3_s5_16: Hiroko, Moe, and Anji all paled at once, crowding around in an instant:
nodes.ar3_s5_18: Catching her balance against Sakaguchi's arm, Artoria felt a rare flush of mortification brush the tips of her fair ears. Drawing a quick breath, she straightened her spine at once to reclaim the dignity of Deputy Chief of Surgery:
nodes.ar3_s5_19: "...Forgive me. I am quite alright, Dr. Sakaguchi—no need for alarm, my vision merely blurred for a second standing up..."
nodes.ar3_s5_20: Not letting go right away, Sakaguchi took a close look at her slightly pale lips, warm steady radial pulse, and clear gaze—nothing suggesting acute organic illness, and everything pointing to textbook orthostatic lightheadedness and fatigue from prolonged fasting stacked atop a four-hour high-intensity operation.
nodes.ar3_s5_21: Reading the exact same culprit at a glance, Hiroko set aside her usual deferential smile, knitting her brows slightly as she pressed:
nodes.ar3_s5_22: "Dr. Artoria, it is nearly three in the afternoon. Naturally you haven't eaten lunch yet—what about breakfast this morning?"
nodes.ar3_s5_23: "...As for breakfast, I originally intended to visit the cafeteria at seven-thirty."
nodes.ar3_s5_24: Anji zeroed straight in on the phrasing:
nodes.ar3_s5_25: "'Originally intended'?! Meaning you never actually made it there?!"
nodes.ar3_s5_26: Shifting her gaze half an inch aside, Artoria kept her voice impeccably proper, though her pause stretched twice as long as usual:
nodes.ar3_s5_27: "...At seven-thirty Ward Two needed an urgent overnight bed swap coordinated, so I stepped in; by the time I returned it was eight-ten, right on schedule for Room One's pre-op check... I did have half a cup of black tea this morning, however."
nodes.ar3_s5_28: Glancing up at the wall clock, Sakaguchi couldn't resist adding one more piece of evidence:
nodes.ar3_s5_29: "And if memory serves, you didn't leave the doctors' office until nearly nine last night after reviewing today's gastrectomy plan, did you?"
nodes.ar3_s5_31: Beneath four pairs of unblinking eyes, the Deputy Chief of Surgery who had just commanded the operating room with unshakable poise fell into a longer and longer silence.
nodes.ar3_s5_32: At that exact second, an unmistakably clear—almost aggrieved—"grumble..." echoed through the quiet break room.
nodes.ar3_s5_33: The air froze for a full beat.
nodes.ar3_s5_34: A visible wash of pink rose across Artoria's cheeks; clearing her throat softly, she tried one last dignified holdout:
nodes.ar3_s5_35: "...Two minutes off my feet will be plenty before I head down to the third floor—"
nodes.ar3_s5_37: Moe Honjo—ordinarily the most timid about raising her voice before a senior—took a brave half-step forward, threw both arms wide across the break-room doorway, and turned Artoria's own words squarely back on her with flushed cheeks and dead-earnest conviction:
nodes.ar3_s5_38: "Dr. Artoria said it yourself not two minutes ago—a leader is someone who serves the team too! And if that's true, then Dr. Artoria yourself is obviously one of the most important members of our team!"
nodes.ar3_s5_39: "When a teammate pushes herself on an empty stomach until she's dizzy, the rest of us have a duty to stop you and take proper care of you! Until you've eaten a real meal today, you are strictly forbidden from going down to the third floor to check rosters!"
nodes.ar3_s5_40: Staring in blank astonishment at the eighteen-year-old nurse standing guard before her, Artoria parted her lips—and for once could not find half a syllable of rebuttal.
nodes.ar3_s5_41: Smiling in instant solidarity, Hiroko took Artoria gently yet firmly by the other shoulder, eased her straight down onto the long break-room sofa, and briskly steeped a warm cup of sugared black tea into her hands:
nodes.ar3_s5_42: "I second Moe completely this time. Here, Dr. Artoria—take a couple of sips of warm sweet tea first."
nodes.ar3_s5_43: Already in top gear, Anji snatched up her coin purse and bolted for the door:
nodes.ar3_s5_44: "The first-floor kiosk just got a fresh two-thirty batch of hot fried menchi-katsu sandwiches, teriyaki chicken buns, and warm rice balls! Moe, Hiroko-senpai, Dr. Sakaguchi—keep eyes on the Deputy Chief so she doesn't slip out; I'll be back in three minutes flat!!"
nodes.ar3_s5_45: Between Anji sprinting down the hall, Moe guarding the doorway like a determined little sentry, and Hiroko smilingly topping up hot tea, Artoria Pendragon—parked squarely in the middle of the sofa cradling her teacup—wore a rare look caught halfway between helplessness and sheepish embarrassment.
nodes.ar3_c3a_01: Leaning beside the arm of the sofa watching the deputy chief's reddened ears, Sakaguchi smiled:
nodes.ar3_c3a_02: "Looks like the team you trained has already mastered putting your lessons into immediate practice. Since the vote is unanimous, just be a good teammate and let everyone take care of you this once, Dr. Artoria."
nodes.ar3_c3a_03: Cradling the warm teacup as she listened to his teasing, the sheepishness in Artoria's eyes gradually softened into a quiet warmth:
nodes.ar3_c3a_04: "...Checkmated by my own words—there really is no arguing my way out of this one."
nodes.ar3_c3b_01: Reaching over naturally, Sakaguchi slid the afternoon dressing-change checklist off the top of the folder on her lap:
nodes.ar3_c3b_02: "Leave the third-floor sheet to me on my way past. Until you finish every bite of lunch Anji brings back, don't give errands outside a single thought."
nodes.ar3_c3b_03: Blinking faintly, Artoria looked up at Sakaguchi; dropping any stiff formality, she offered a quiet thank-you:
nodes.ar3_c3c_01: Sakaguchi shook his head in wry amusement:
nodes.ar3_c3c_02: "Last time after the hepatic lobectomy it was one-forty without lunch, and today you went ahead and pushed the record close to three. Leave you unsupervised much longer and we'll have to start sticking a dextrose drip in you right off the table."
nodes.ar3_c3c_03: Beside them, both Hiroko and Moe couldn't help bursting into soft laughter.
nodes.ar3_c3c_04: Taking a small sip of hot black tea with pink-tipped ears, Artoria murmured a quiet defense:
nodes.ar3_c3c_05: "...Those were merely two isolated coincidences; ordinarily I take my meals quite properly."
nodes.ar3_s5r_01: Before the words had scarcely faded, Anji came dashing back carrying a bulging bag of piping-hot food and arrayed it neatly across the low coffee table before the sofa.
nodes.ar3_s5r_02: Under four pairs of watchful eyes, Artoria Pendragon sat impeccably upright, accepted the paper bag in both hands, and murmured a quiet "Thank you for the meal."
nodes.ar3_s5r_03: Though her table manners remained unimpeachably poised and graceful, the steaming fried beef-cutlet sandwich, teriyaki chicken bun, and two salmon rice balls vanished cleanly into thin air within mere minutes at a steady clip that left onlookers privately amazed.
nodes.ar3_s5r_04: By the time she finished the last sip of warm black tea, healthy color had returned in full to her previously pale cheeks.
nodes.ar3_s5r_05: Moe let out a long breath of relief:
nodes.ar3_s5r_07: Dabbing her fingertips clean with a napkin and folding the wrappers into neat squares, Artoria inclined her upper body toward her teammates in earnest gratitude:
nodes.ar3_s5r_08: "Thank you all for the meal, and forgive me for causing you concern—my strength has completely returned."
nodes.ar3_s5r_09: Half a beat after delivering those impeccably dignified thanks, her emerald eyes drifted ever so casually toward the shopping bag Anji hadn't folded away yet; in the exact same grave, earnest tone she had used on the table to announce a change of surgical approach, she asked politely:
nodes.ar3_s5r_10: "...Um, Anji. Assuming the first-floor kiosk still has ample stock today... would it be too much trouble to add one more of those fried beef-cutlet sandwiches? I have the money right here."
nodes.ar3_s5r_11: Silence fell over the break area for a second.
nodes.ar3_s5r_13: "Eh—?! Th-that whole bag just now was enough for Moe and me combined, and you still have room for seconds, Dr. Artoria?!"
nodes.ar3_s5r_14: Without changing expression by a hair, Artoria answered squarely:
nodes.ar3_s5r_15: "Having just stood through a four-hour abdominal operation, replenishing sufficient caloric reserve is simply prudent preparation for afternoon duties."
nodes.ar3_s5r_16: Moe and Hiroko burst out laughing in unison, while Anji grinned—quizzing "Alright, alright—off I go to grab the last two for the Deputy Chief!"—and dashed cheerily back toward the stairs.
nodes.ar3_s5r_17: Warm afternoon sunlight spilled across the lively break area.
nodes.ar3_s5r_18: Standing beside the table, Sakaguchi watched Artoria Pendragon surrounded by the young nurses, an unguarded, relaxed smile finally softening the corner of her mouth.
nodes.ar3_s5r_19: Today he had witnessed beyond a shadow of a doubt the kind of reassuring strength this Deputy Chief of Surgery possessed—not only a blade steady as bedrock in her own hand, but the gift of making every person beside her believe they were an irreplaceable part of the team.
nodes.ar3_s5r_20: Only, watching how instinctively she shouldered everyone else's growth and burdens onto her own back until hunger literally made her sway, a quiet, unspoken thought crossed Sakaguchi's mind for the briefest instant—
nodes.ar3_s5r_21: Days like today—where simply taking a little extra weight onto herself lets everyone walk away whole—are ideal; yet if a day comes when competing needs inside the team collide head-on, and sacrificing herself alone can no longer satisfy everyone... how will a leader who always serves her team choose then?
nodes.ar3_s5r_22: Sakaguchi kept that question to himself.
nodes.ar3_s5r_23: Beside the coffee table, accepting the fresh warm sandwich Anji hurried back with and eating in small yet remarkably swift bites, Artoria glanced up, met Sakaguchi's warm gaze, and gave a slight, smiling nod. As for the true answer awaiting a Chief of Surgery and a leader—there would be plenty of time for the days ahead to reveal it.
